public_rationale: The figure comes from anonymous sources the speaker cites. Searches found no Microsoft disclosure and no reliable independent report of GPU utilization for Microsoft 365 enterprise Copilot. Coverage that repeats the 60% figure traces back to his newsletter, so it cannot count as evidence. One site claimed utilization above 70%, but its details could not be verified, so it was not used. With no reliable evidence for either side, the claim stays unresolved.
limitations: Infrastructure utilization data is internal to Microsoft and is rarely disclosed.
'Utilization' could be measured in several ways.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GPU utilization for Microsoft 365 enterprise Copilot is barely 60%.

statement.excerpt: Oh, one other thing: sources also confirm GPU utilization for Microsoft 365’s enterprise Copilot is barely scratching 60%.

our_interpretation: Plain reading: GPU capacity serving Microsoft 365 enterprise Copilot was used at about 60%, not much above it, around the time of the post.
He names no period. I take the most recent period before the post, roughly August to September 2025, since the nearby text cites August figures. I do not limit it to August alone.
criteria.support_condition: A Microsoft disclosure or independent reporting showing utilization of GPUs serving Microsoft 365 enterprise Copilot at roughly 60% (for example about 55–65%) around August–September 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A Microsoft disclosure or independent reporting showing that utilization for that period was clearly different, for example well above 70%.
